items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the advance-payment assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Beispielsoest eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter states a separate posting date: 'Aufgabe zur Post Samstag, 21.11.2026', so this governs delivery instead of the Bescheid date. Under the 4-day rule (posting on/after 1 Jan 2025), delivery = posting day + 4 calendar days = 21.11.2026 + 4 = 25.11.2026 (Wednesday). This is a Finanzamt, so if the 4th day were a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day, but 25.11.2026 is already a plain Wednesday, so delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 25.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§355 Abs.1 AO, counted per §108 Abs.1 AO / §187, §188 BGB) starts the day after delivery and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 25.11.2026 -> 25.12.2026. 25.12.2026 (Friday) is 1. Weihnachtstag (nationwide public holiday); the following day 26.12.2026 (Saturday) is 2. Weihnachtstag (also a nationwide holiday) and falls on a Saturday; 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. The period therefore ends on the next working day, Monday 28.12.2026 (§108 Abs.3 AO / §193 BGB).
